newsitem.title: USA: APPLIED CELLULAR ACQUIRES STAKE IN UK FIRM.
newsitem.headline: APPLIED CELLULAR ACQUIRES STAKE IN UK FIRM.

text.p: Applied Cellular Technology Inc said Thursday that it has acquired 80 percent of Signal Processors Ltd, a leading UK manufacturer of satellite communications equipment.
The acquisition will have an effective accounting date of May 1, 1997, and is expected to add about $7 to $9 million in revenues and $750,000 in earnings over the coming year, Applied Cellular said.
Signal Processors holds more than 12 patents for its core technology and is based at the Cambridge Science Park in England, Applied Cellular said.

Applied Cellular also said Thursday it has created the subsidiary Applied Cellular Technology International Ltd and has appointed Kevin O'Keeffe to the position of Managing Director of that subsidiary.
Applied Cellular shares were up 1/4 at 5-1/4.
